intent: The right-rail surface — a fixed-width bordered column that stacks the panel-section children it is given, top-to-bottom.
guidance: Panel owns only the surface: a fixed 290px width, the bg/default ground, a 1px inset hairline ring, and top-to-bottom flex stacking. It adds no header, scroll, or inner padding — compose it from PanelSection children and wrap it in a ScrollArea when the stack overflows. Style with the c-* tokens so light and dark track. Panel sets no ARIA role, so label the rail at the host level or let each PanelSection opt into a region landmark. The 290px width is deliberate (widened from 240 so two-column numeric field rows stop truncating); override it via className only when a host genuinely needs a different rail.

anatomy.description: The 290px-wide column: bg/default ground with a 1px inset hairline ring in border/translucent; lays children out with flex-col.
The children, stacked top-to-bottom in the column — PanelSection rows and field rows in the order given.

use_when: Building a right-rail inspector or sidebar by stacking PanelSection children.
You want a fixed-width bordered surface whose ground and border track light/dark via tokens.
dont_use_when: You need the header plus fixed overlay-scrollbar shell — use Inspector.
The surface must float above content with edge-aware placement — use an overlay/dialog primitive.

slots.children: The stacked panel content, rendered top-to-bottom in the column (PanelSection rows and field rows).
slots.className: Host-supplied class overrides merged onto the surface (e.g. a non-default width).

tokens.note: 290px fixed width (PANEL_W) applied as an inline style — a hardcoded dimension, not a token; the ring is a 1px inset hairline.

a11y.role: none — renders a plain div surface and sets no ARIA role.
a11y.landmark: Semantics come from the host (wrap or label the rail) or from each PanelSection opting into a region landmark.
a11y.label: Panel takes no aria-label of its own; label the rail at the composition/host level.
